card.summary: S. 2016 authorizes and directs a land exchange between the Chugach Alaska Corporation and the federal government. Under the bill, if the corporation offers to convey roughly 231,000 acres of subsurface estate to the Department of the Interior within one year, the federal government must exchange it for approximately 65,374 acres of fee simple land located in the Chugach region.
